hypothesis: Cross-sectional one-month reversal combined with a low-volatility tilt and a long-term momentum filter among liquid US equities produces positive dollar-neutral returns. Recent monthly losers with below-median volatility and non-negative 6-to-12 month momentum tend to rebound, while recent winners with high volatility underperform. Monthly rebalancing at the first trading day controls transaction costs, and equal-weight 30 long / 30 short positions respect gross and position limits.
